author: tamarafU5009JT

title: Amazing very personalized tour!!
text: Antonio was an excellent tour guide!! He took us to the most beautiful beaches of Costa Brava. Went out of his way to make lunch reservations for us with a beautiful view of the water. Visited a beautiful village and was happy to take lots of pictures of us!! I would highly recommend him and when return to Barcelona we will definitely book tours with him again!!
author: Priscilla M

title: Amazing day touring Barcelona outskirts
text: My wife, sister, and I headed out on the full day tour with Antonio in mid-October. All of us very much enjoyed our day and found Antonio a wealth of knowledge. Antonio coordinated with us early for pick up time and location. He met us on time, and we had a comfortable ride out to the countryside. We very much enjoyed the locations we visited,  Antonio did a great job of filling in time between locations with local history and facts. We were able to tweak sites and focused on the beaches. author: claytons467

title: Relaxing Day Exploring Costa Brava
text: We had such a fun day touring the Costa Brava region with Antonio!  We loved all our stops - the first fishing village with the different colored doors, the stop for an amazing seafood lunch right on the water, the amazing medieval villages just inland.  Thank you for sharing your knowledge and love of the region with us, Antonio!
author: Kim_S
